definition.fixed_data: j,Lambda,delta,Pstar,P0,G and analytic tube held fixed

weighted_norm: sum_{i+k<=m} sup|d_radial^i d_Z^k|/(i!k!); physical unweighted C3<=6*weighted

physical_amplitude_units.angular_moments: Cstar*Mtheta and Cstar*Mtheta_z have the displayed coefficient bounds
physical_amplitude_units.pressure_moment: Cstar^2*Mp has the displayed coefficient bound
physical_amplitude_units.energy_moment: Mztheta has degrees0 and -2; bound the sum of both positive coefficients
physical_amplitude_units.frozen_D: angular Cstar^-1 factors cancel against f; remaining coefficient is degree0
physical_amplitude_units.frozen_E: E=Cstar*E0+Cstar^-1*E2 for each normalized profile; |E|/Cstar is bounded by both coefficients
physical_amplitude_units.variable_profiles: Phi and V can depend on Cstar through the nonlinear equations; their bounds are uniform, not identical point solutions
physical_amplitude_units.K: all displayed terms have degree at most1 after factoring physical amplitudes; Cstar>=1 gives K<=Kbar*Cstar

finite_jet_proofs.product: factorial-weighted Taylor-jet l1 norm is submultiplicative by coefficient convolution
finite_jet_proofs.exp: write g=g0+t in the degree-m truncated Taylor ring; t^(m+1)=0; exp(g)=exp(g0)*sum_{n=0}^m t^n/n!; bounded by exp(sup g)*(m+1)*(1+||g||_m)^m
finite_jet_proofs.log_Phi: write Phi=Phi0+t; bound constant log Phi0 separately and use log(1+t/Phi0)=sum_{n=1}^m (-1)^(n+1)(t/Phi0)^n/n; ||t||<=||Phi||, Phi0>=phi_floor
finite_jet_proofs.reciprocal: finite inverse jet (1/q0)*sum_{n=0}^m (-t/q0)^n; positive zeroth-order floors for Phi,L,Df come from the analytic positivity receipts
finite_jet_proofs.primitive: radial value plus shifted radial derivative coefficients are bounded by (S+1)*||integrand||_m; this deliberately overcounts positive terms
finite_jet_proofs.stress_derivative: weighted C3 of a Z derivative is <=4*weighted C4; all frozen stress numerators are charged four derivatives
finite_jet_proofs.physical_C3: for i+k<=3, i!k!<=6, so the unweighted derivative sum is <=6 times the weighted norm

extension_proof: the normalized fixed-point majorants depend on Cstar only through the F0^2 upper; the physical amplitude powers are separately recorded in physical_amplitude_units

frozen_branchwise_uniform_extension_proo.angular: same uniform Phi floor/ceiling, Psi norms and correction norms hold for the full amplitude envelope; all forcing/barrier/Qentry/S0/moment-error bounds are unchanged as bounds
frozen_branchwise_uniform_extension_proo.high_chi: chi and Lambda are fixed; polynomial slope majorant and Phi correction remain uniform; the signed-logF decomposition uses g_axis and normalized derivatives, not logCstar
frozen_branchwise_uniform_extension_proo.low_chi: pressure atoms,Pstar,j and root localization stay fixed; velocity and cumulative-average bounds are uniform; F0<=exp(-2logLambda-1000) and its derivative envelope hold for all larger Cstar
frozen_branchwise_uniform_extension_proo.H: low-chi N pressure floor survives the same physical F^2/F^2_Z upper bounds; f stays positive; the upper f bound gives the same lower |E|; D>0 permits H>=2|E|
frozen_branchwise_uniform_extension_proo.Dfloor: the angular proof therefore keeps Df>=4*epsilon*Qglobal>0 for every family member
frozen_branchwise_uniform_extension_proo.no_pointwise_monotonicity_claim: normalized Phi,V need not be monotone in Cstar; the unchanged rectangular analytic envelopes, not a monotone point profile, transfer the proof
